prompt.en: The guide says the northern territories have mines. Which other energy resource does it say is being developed there?
prompt.fr: Le guide dit que les territoires du Nord ont des mines. Quelle autre ressource énergétique y est mise en valeur, selon lui?

options.fr: Des gisements de pétrole et de gaz.

explanation.en: As well as its mines, the North holds oil and gas underground. The guide says work is under way to develop those deposits.
explanation.fr: En plus de ses mines, le Nord renferme du pétrole et du gaz dans son sous-sol. Le guide indique que ces gisements sont en cours de mise en valeur.

source.quote: Oil and gas deposits are being developed

verification.evidence: The Northwest Territories, Nunavut and Yukon … There are gold, lead, copper, diamond and zinc mines. Oil and gas deposits are being developed.
